services.value: Traut Companies provides municipal & commercial water system services including dual rotary drilling, geothermal heating & cooling installation (IGSHPA-accredited installer), small & large pump service, VFD solutions, downhole geophysical data logging & well video inspection, and water treatment and installation/service. The company also operates a “Minnesota State Certified Water Analysis Lab” that analyzes drinking water contaminants (e.g., bacteria, nitrates, arsenic, lead, manganese).
